'''Alex Bayer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Albany tournament (23 June)]] on 23 June 2001 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|RST (podracing)]], according to Mike d'Amboise's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2521">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-25-dude-wheres-my-tech-albany-6-25d2521/ dude-wheres-my-tech-albany-6-25], DeckTech (Mike "Luckywild" Damboise, 25 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-25-dude-wheres-my-tech-albany-6-25d2521/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
